description: Find upcoming The Dinner Table Club dinner parties for strangers, filtered by city and date range. Each result has the restaurant, neighborhood, local date and time, price per person (dinner included), whether seats are left, and a link to the event page where tickets are sold. Cities: New York (NYC), Washington DC, Los Angeles (LA), Miami. San Francisco is coming soon.

city.description: Which The Dinner Table Club city to search. Omit for all cities.

end_date.description: Latest date to include, YYYY-MM-DD, in the city's local time. Omit for no end date.

include_sold_out.description: Include sold-out dinners (they have a waitlist). Defaults to true.

limit.description: Maximum number of dinners to return. Defaults to 20.

start_date.description: Earliest date to include, YYYY-MM-DD, in the city's local time. Defaults to today.

name: find_dinners

event_page_url.description: Details and tickets. Share this link.

image_url.description: Photo from a past Dinner Table Club dinner, for display

price_from_usd.description: Lowest ticket price per person, dinner included

title: Find dinners
